message.content: LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. Born on December 30, 1984, he played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School in Akron, Ohio, where he gained national attention. He was drafted first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 NBA Draft and has since played for the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers (again), and the Los Angeles Lakers. LeBron has won multiple NBA championships, earned numerous MVP awards, and has been selected to the All‑NBA First Team many times. Off the court, he is known for his philanthropy—particularly the LeBron James Family Foundation—and his involvement in media and business ventures.
